name: Ischemic acute tubular injury
value: 58-year-old man, 2 days after a massive upper GI bleed with shock (systolic BP under 80 for 3 hours before transfusion): urine output 250 mL/day despite fluids. BP now 132/78. Creatinine 1.0 rising to 4.6 mg/dL, K 5.9 mEq/L. UA shed epithelial cells and casts.
